suggestedTitle: Remote Control Design Project Kickoff & Icebreaker

summarySections.heading: Project Overview & Design Process
bullets: Discussion: Participant 1 explained that the design project involves three distinct stages.
Discussion: The project structure alternates between individual work and group meetings repeated three times.
Discussion: Participant 2 confirmed receiving the initial project announcement regarding designing a remote control.

summarySections.heading: Whiteboard Icebreaker Activity
bullets: Discussion: Participant 1 initiated an icebreaker activity on the whiteboard, asking team members to draw their favorite animal and describe its key characteristics.
Discussion: Participant 3 volunteered to go first and selected a beagle as their favorite animal.
Discussion: Participant 3 listed top desired animal characteristics, including willingness to accept physical affection, strong personality, fitness, and robust health.
